intent: A grounded weekly decision aid, not a longer statistics paraphrase.
reader_outcomes: Understand the week without reading a long essay

sections.name: 本周最重要的结论
sections.answers: 先保持什么、先改什么、下一周先做什么？
sections.format: one-screen overview, up to three evidence-linked decisions

sections.name: 目标与实际
sections.answers: 与事先设定的目标和上个可比周期差多少？
sections.format: metric strip, daily chart, short interpretation

sections.name: 科目投入与近期重点
sections.answers: 投入与已输入的目标、考试及剩余任务是否匹配？

sections.name: 计划执行与估时偏差
sections.answers: 哪些任务没做完？哪些同类任务估时明显不准？
sections.format: matched estimate/actual table, sample coverage, tentative adjustment

sections.name: 下周容量与截止日期
sections.answers: 现有任务到底排不排得下？需要舍弃什么？

sections.name: 可审阅的下周安排
sections.answers: 具体做什么，放在哪一天，遇到超时怎么调整？
sections.format: validated candidate schedule, keep/defer list, fallback action

sections.name: 建议追踪与多周变化
sections.answers: 上次采纳的建议做了没有？最近几周发生了什么变化？
sections.format: accepted-action status table and comparable trend

sections.name: 数据依据与分析边界
sections.answers: 这些结论可信吗？有哪些没有记录？
sections.format: short coverage/unknowns notes; detailed audit at the end

reasoning_unit.evidence_refs: Existing evidence IDs, visible sample size and time scope
reasoning_unit.interpretation: Why this may matter to the stated goal; qualify unknown causes
reasoning_unit.check_next_week: A measurable follow-up, without grading learning quality

output_contract.sections: ordered section IDs with available/limited/unavailable states and evidence-linked prose
output_contract.selected_plan_id: must reference an application-validated candidate, not invented time slots
output_contract.actions: at most three priorities with stable recommendation IDs and supported task refs
output_contract.unknowns: explicit missing fields; do not replace missing values with zero

generation_pipeline: Build bounded factual snapshots locally with an explicit cutoff/timezone
Compute metrics and generate deadline/availability-safe candidate plans with existing deterministic engines
Show eligible analysis areas and missing inputs before generation
Obtain explicit consent; preserve default subject anonymisation and exclusion of private notes/raw logs/task titles
DeepSeek receives whitelisted aggregates, stable anonymous references and approved candidate plans
Validate schema, evidence refs, quoted numbers, task IDs, candidate IDs and constraints; reject invalid output
Render an overview plus full sections and export the same saved content
Apply only after user confirmation; link accepted recommendation IDs to created or changed tasks
At the next report, evaluate linked status and comparable metrics without claiming causality

current_data_gaps.state: history exists but weekly AI pack currently sends only daily goal counts

current_data_gaps.item: Task-level estimate/effort pairs and week-start plan baseline
current_data_gaps.state: local task history exists; current AI pack contains aggregate totals, not bounded task-level pairs

current_data_gaps.item: Exam deadline, availability, remaining work and candidate schedules
current_data_gaps.state: planning/exam engines exist; not yet wired into weekly AI contract
add bounded snapshots and stable anonymous subject mapping across weeks; previous-period AI facts currently contain only totals/counts/days
add persistent recommendation-to-task links and dated status snapshots; not currently part of AI weekly data

thin_data_policy.before_generation: Explain which analyses are supported and what inputs are missing, without forcing a long onboarding form
thin_data_policy.limited_report: Show a candid starting report; do not pad missing sections with generic encouragement
thin_data_policy.allowance: Proposed: do not silently consume a full-depth report allowance for an insufficient-data summary; commercial policy still needs confirmation
thin_data_policy.first_report: Previous-action section says no history; no invented previous advice

quality_gates: Every priority includes evidence, a reason, an actionable adjustment and a next check
No invented attention/efficiency/mastery score, diagnosis, grades or guaranteed gains
Counts and comparisons use consistent scope; current weeks compare equal elapsed periods
No causation inferred from time or task status; subject allocation is not automatically imbalance
Matched estimates use completed, historically known tasks; state lifetime/period effort and n
Unknown task completion/goal/remaining-time history is excluded or labelled
Schedule accounts for breaks, locked/running blocks, deadlines and user availability; no automatic calendar write
Do not fabricate an optimal study method from time totals
Every exported finding and graph matches its saved online snapshot; reading/downloading uses no new AI call
Sparse input, inconsistent records, missing availability, first report, overdue exams and stale plans all need representative acceptance cases

layout.web: single report, one clear download action, short overview followed by expanded analysis; no nested feature menu
layout.print: approximately 3-4 pages when data supports depth, reflow without truncation; do not pad to a page count
layout.type: serif short titles + readable sans body, figures aligned to common edges
layout.colour: existing warm paper, terracotta emphasis, ochre for comparisons, restrained apricot/honey annotations
layout.prose: detailed enough to explain decisions, concise within each section; never use word count as a substitute for value

release_limit: This artifact does not change the current runtime, subscription pricing/allowance or public feature promises. Real DeepSeek configuration, trial output evaluation and cost measurement are still required.
